messages:
Alicia Park: Hey all  I accepted the "New Hire Orientation" invite but it shows 07:00 in my calendar (I'm UTC+9) and there's no Zoom link in the event body. Also I see the event twice one as a weekly series and one as a single day. Did I break something? :confused:
Onboarding Bot: Hi Alicia! We run separate recurrences for AMER and APAC/EU which can cause duplicate entries if your calendar subscribes to both. The Zoom link should be on the APAC event. Recording will be posted to Confluence after the session. Organizer: Samir Gupta.
Samir Gupta: Thanks for flagging @Alicia  looks like you got added to the AMER series and the APAC one accidentally. APAC one is titled "Orientation  APAC/EU" and the join URL is: https://zoom.us/j/3141592653
Samir Gupta: Passcode: treehouse (lowercase). If you prefer I can remove the AMER recurrence from your calendar so only the APAC instance remains.
Alicia Park: Ah ok! I'm on a company-managed Exchange account and the subscribed calendar shows times in UTC not local  mobile app shows the wrong time too. Would removing the extra series fix mobile?
Marta (DevEx): Short checklist: 1) Remove subscription to the global "Orientation Series" calendar. 2) Import the single APAC-event ICS (Event -> More actions -> Export -> Save .ics) into your mailbox instead of subscribing. That usually fixes mobile and Outlook display issues. For Google Calendar import: Settings -> Import & export -> Import. For Outlook: File -> Open & Export -> Import/Export -> Import an iCalendar (.ics).
Marta (DevEx): If you need the raw ICS file, DM me and Ill send it. Also watch for DTSTART lines with a trailing Z (UTC)  some clients don't convert those correctly.
Noelle (People Ops): Recording + transcript will be placed in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings within 24 hours and retained for 90 days. Need longer retention? Email people-ops@redwood.com. If you need live captions or a signer, request 48+ hours ahead.
Alicia Park: Thanks everyone  I removed the subscription and imported the single-event ICS; mobile calendar and Outlook both look correct now :thumbsup:
Onboarding Bot: Organizer updated event metadata: region=APAC, removed duplicate recurrence for attendee Alicia Park, added Zoom link to event description, attendees re-notified. :white_check_mark:
Samir Gupta: Welcome aboard @Alicia  ping me here if you want the pre-setup checklist (Slack, GitHub, Okta) before orientation. We'll post slides and the recording link after the call.
